title: Small-team path
disclaimer: A two-person shop cannot lease Round Top or pour a 20,000 tpd heap. This card is the other path: one novel unit operation, government money sized for a bench, then a skid, then kilograms a customer will sign for. Not a mine NPV. Award sizes are class, not a promise a window is open tomorrow. Check SBIR.gov before writing a proposal.
rule: Novel processing, government funded, two people hire and build, verify kilograms, then expand. Never the mountain.
review_hooks: Next DOE or DLA SBIR/STTR topic that names Dy, HREE split, or magnet scrap?
Next CMI Accelerator scrap window (Topic 1A/1B class) and cost-share?
DLA Strategic Materials BAA SP8000-26-B-BAA0 still taking white papers?
Any public kg-scale result from TUSAAR, ReElement, Phoenix Tailings, or Wheat Ridge swarf that closes the wedge?

wedges.name: Dy/Y split on Y-heavy sulfate
wedges.why: Round Top liquor is a yttrium problem. PC88A only prefers Dy about 3–4×, so a mountain plant needs a long mixer-settler cascade. A better β, a membrane, an ionic-liquid extractant, or a polish resin that cuts stage count is a product.
wedges.metric: β(Dy/Y) and stage count vs PC88A on a named Y-heavy sulfate feed, F still present

wedges.name: F / U / Th cut that does not poison SX
wedges.why: Comparison tab rank 2. Yttrofluorite leach puts fluoride and some radionuclides into the liquor. No public Round Top mass balance. If the cut leaves HREEs and does not wreck the organic, heap plants buy it as a service or a skid.
wedges.metric: Dy loss across the cut; residual F, U, Th; extractant cycles after the cut

wedges.name: Swarf → spec Dy2O3 on a modular skid
wedges.why: Feed is already concentrated. USAR Wheat Ridge already made Dy oxide from Stillwater swarf. TUSAAR, Cyclic, Noveon, Ionic/USSM occupy parts of this pond. Win only on $/kg, cleaner radionuclides, or a skid a magnet plant will park on site.
wedges.metric: kg Dy2O3 per day, impurity package a magnet alloy shop will read, $/kg vs buying oxide

do_not: Pitch a second heap or a GLO lease on Round Top
Apply to CHIPS or the $67–134M demo-facility class
Paste the $575/kg Serra Verde Dy floor onto a two-person P/L
Hire a CEO before a chemist who has run settlers or columns

ladder.name: Claim
ladder.what: LLC, IP at the company, one sentence metric, named surrogate feed (bought magnet swarf or synthetic Y-heavy sulfate + F). No USAR ore story.
ladder.gate: Can you state the metric and the feed in one sentence?

ladder.name: Prove (Phase I)
ladder.cash: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I up to $305k / 6–18 mo; DoD/DLA Phase I class $100–250k / ~12 mo. No equity.
ladder.what: 6–12 months. 1–10 L mass balance. Third-party assay. Report β, F tolerance, U/Th rejection, extractant cycles.
ladder.gate: Independent assay of product. No mass balance, no Phase II.

ladder.name: Hire + build (Phase II)
ladder.cash: NSF Phase II up to $1.25M; DLA Phase II class ~$1M / 18 mo; DOE Accelerator Topic 1 scrap Phase 1 ~$2M at ~20% cost share.
ladder.what: Build one skid (columns, hollow-fiber, or a small SX battery). Not a pad. Run on someone else's feed.
ladder.gate: Skid runs on named real feed (swarf PO, MREC sample), not a fantasy ore pile.

ladder.name: Verify
ladder.cash: Same Phase II pot. DoD TIA / DPA Title III class comes after kilograms exist.
ladder.what: Kilograms of Dy2O3, not a slide. Named customer qualification letter (magnet alloy or oxide spec). Radiation/waste plan if the feed is dirty.
ladder.gate: A PO, an MOU with kilograms, or a plant-gate trial. Samples are not verify.

ladder.name: Expand
ladder.cash: Customer + Phase III / BAA Phase II / seed. Not CHIPS. DLA Strategic Materials BAA SP8000-26-B-BAA0 is a rolling white-paper path (cited through Jan 2029).
ladder.what: Second skid, toll kg→t, or license the unit-op to whoever runs a heap or a magnet plant.
ladder.gate: Only expand on contracted feed. Still not 20,000 tpd.

funding_class.name: NSF SBIR/STTR (NSF 26-510 class)
funding_class.note: Project Pitch first. No equity. Recurring solicitation, not a one-shot FOA.

funding_class.name: DoD/DLA REE-separation SBIR
funding_class.note: DLA26BZ02-NV002 closed 24 Jun 2026. Use as template; next cycle repeats the topic shape. TRL 3–6, ITAR/EAR.

funding_class.name: DOE CMI Accelerator Topic 1A/1B scrap
funding_class.note: Hire+build money. 2026 window timed out — watch the next CMI drop. Not garage-scale.

funding_class.name: DLA Strategic Materials BAA SP8000-26-B-BAA0
funding_class.note: Rolling 30 Jan 2026–30 Jan 2029. Covers NdFeB recycle and REE recovery. Confirm still open before a paper.
